subject.title: feat(ios): record and send voice notes from the chat composer

question: Should maintainers accept this iOS-only async voice-note v1 once the branch is refreshed and real iOS record/send proof is supplied, or hold it for a broader mobile plan?
rationale: The PR implements a new first-party mobile input mode on a protected maintainer-labeled item; automation can review code shape, but maintainers need to confirm the product scope and proof bar before merge.

options.title: Proceed with iOS v1 after proof
options.body: Keep this PR as the iOS implementation candidate once conflicts are resolved and redacted real-device or simulator evidence shows recording, finishing, staging, and sending a voice note.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller iOS slice or additional device proof around mic permission, Talk, and Voice Wake coordination before enabling the composer control.

options.title: Defer to the broader issue
options.body: Pause this PR and use the linked issue for a cross-platform design that lands iOS and Android together or in an explicit sequence.

recommendation.title: Proceed with iOS v1 after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the iOS implementation candidate once conflicts are resolved and redacted real-device or simulator evidence shows recording, finishing, staging, and sending a voice note.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the linked feature context and recent current-main mobile/chat voice work in the inspected history.
